description: Dashboard de monitoreo de energía en tiempo real. Proporciona análisis detallados de potencia, corriente, voltaje y consumo acumulado por día, mes y año.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS lastUpdate
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    time_bucket('15 minutes', time) AS time, 
    MAX(p1 + p2 + p3) AS "max", 
    MIN(p1 + p2 + p3) AS "min", 
    AVG(p1 + p2 + p3) AS "mean"   
FROM sensor_data  
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND time BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AND NOW()
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 1 DESC 
LIMIT 100;

SELECT (p1 + p2 + p3) AS power
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT (fp1 + fp2 + fp3) / 3.0 AS power_factor
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
ORDER BY time DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p1 AS "P1", 
    p2 AS "P2", 
    p3 AS "P3",
    time
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' 
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT 
    c1 AS "I1", 
    c2 AS "I2", 
    c3 AS "I3",
    time
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' 
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT 
    v1 AS "V1", 
    v2 AS "V2", 
    v3 AS "V3",
    time
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' 
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: Consumo de Energía: Hoy, Mes, Año

targets.rawSql:
WITH mediciones AS (
    SELECT
        time,
        (p1 + p2 + p3) AS potencia_actual,
        LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS tiempo_anterior,
        LAG(p1 + p2 + p3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS potencia_anterior
    FROM sensor_data
    WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
      -- Filtramos desde el comienzo del día de hoy (según tu zona horaria)
      AND time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
        ((potencia_actual + potencia_anterior) / 2.0) -- Promedio de potencia (Watts)
        *
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - tiempo_anterior)) / 3600.0) -- Tiempo en horas
    ) / 1000.0, 0) AS energy_today -- Convertimos Watts-hora a kWh
FROM mediciones
WHERE tiempo_anterior IS NOT NULL;

WITH mediciones AS (
    SELECT
        time,
        (p1 + p2 + p3) AS potencia_actual,
        LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS tiempo_anterior,
        LAG(p1 + p2 + p3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS potencia_anterior
    FROM sensor_data
    WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
      AND time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'
)
SELECT
    time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time,
    SUM(
        ((potencia_actual + potencia_anterior) / 2.0)
        *
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - tiempo_anterior)) / 3600.0)
    ) / 1000.0 AS real
FROM mediciones
WHERE tiempo_anterior IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT

    ) / 1000.0, 0) AS energy_month
FROM mediciones

panels.title: Máximos de Corriente, Voltaje y Potencia

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    time_bucket('15 minutes', time) AS time,
    MAX(c1) AS "I1 max"
FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(c1) AS "I1 avg",

GROUP BY time_bucket('15 minutes', time);

SELECT
    100 * AVG(p1) / NULLIF(AVG(p1) + AVG(p2) + AVG(p3), 0) AS "Ph1",
    100 * AVG(p2) / NULLIF(AVG(p1) + AVG(p2) + AVG(p3), 0) AS "Ph2",
    100 * AVG(p3) / NULLIF(AVG(p1) + AVG(p2) + AVG(p3), 0) AS "Ph3"
FROM sensor_data
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
  AND $__timeFilter(time);

WITH mediciones AS (
    SELECT
        time,
        p1, p2, p3,
        LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS t_ant,
        LAG(p1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1_ant,
        LAG(p2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2_ant,
        LAG(p3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3_ant
    FROM sensor_data
    WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}' 
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT
    time_bucket('15 minutes', time) AS time,
    SUM(((p1 + p1_ant) / 2.0) * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - t_ant)) / 3600.0)) / 1000.0 AS ph1,
    SUM(((p2 + p2_ant) / 2.0) * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - t_ant)) / 3600.0)) / 1000.0 AS ph2,
    SUM(((p3 + p3_ant) / 2.0) * (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - t_ant)) / 3600.0)) / 1000.0 AS ph3
FROM mediciones
WHERE t_ant IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

FROM sensor_data 
WHERE sensor_id = '${sensor_id}'
